content:
Maya CS: Heads-up 1 1 1 we need a short outbound to affected EU onboarding customers who saw slowed jobs last night. Draft below, please review for credits/ask/tone.

Olga CS-Mgr: Definitely send. Can we get a prioritized list (trials vs renewals vs pilots)?

Maya CS: I pulled segments: Trials: 7; Renewal-window (<=60d): 3; Enterprise pilots: 5. Plan: auto note to trials, personalized for renewals/pilots.

Ravi AE: Product/infra ETA? Renewals will ask for timelines.

Laura SRE: Quick summary: autoscaler under-provisioned because cross-tenant KV cache pressure spiked. We applied an emergency capacity bump at 22:37 UTC which mitigated the throttling. Permanent fix scheduled in next deploy (approx 03:20 UTC).

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-20T22:05Z 1 1: Embedding inference throttling in eu-* pools. Severity P2. Status: mitigated.

Kofi Support: Draft looks fine but add explicit "how to escalate" steps and status page URL. Also tag tickets for CSM escalation.

Maya CS: Draft v0.9 (please inline edits):

```
Hi {{CustomerName}},

Were writing about a performance issue you may have encountered during onboarding jobs on March 20 (approx 22:0022:45 UTC). Some EU inference nodes experienced temporary throttling which affected embeddings and short-sequence chat requests for a subset of onboarding runs.

What happened
- An autoscaling threshold miscalculation during a traffic spike caused temporary request throttling on the EU inference pool (v2.4).

What we did for you
- Emergency capacity bump at 22:37 UTC to restore throughput.
- We retried prioritized queued onboarding jobs for impacted accounts where possible.
- We applied an automatic credit of up to 15% for customers in the 60-day renewal window or active pilots; trials receive a 10% credit. (Caps apply.)

Next steps
- If you see any stalled jobs, reply to this thread or open a ticket at <support-link> and include the onboarding job id.
- We will publish a high-level incident summary on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents (RCA to follow).

If youd like live assistance, your CSM can schedule an expedited re-run and runbook session.

Apologies for the disruption  we know this interrupts onboarding flow.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```

Olga CS-Mgr: Change "up to 15%" to "up to 15% credit for renewals/pilots, 10% for trials" and add wording for the finance cap ("capped per account"). Also require CSM outreach for renewals/pilots.

Noah Finance: Confirmed: cap at $5,000 per account for this incident window. Please keep language as "up to".

Sam Product: Please add this clarification: "This did not impact Dedicated Reserved pools or private deployments." Also note: "Embeddings batch jobs will be retried automatically unless you opt out."

Maya CS: Updated draft with the product/finance notes. Also added an opt-out line for batch retries.

Ravi AE: I'll prepare the renewal/pilot outreach templates and collect contact emails for the 3 renewal accounts. I'll coordinate with AMs and join standup.

Kofi Support: Ticket template created: CS-ONBOARD-THROTTLE. Fields: account, job id, timestamp, retry status, assigned CSM. Escalation path: @oncall-sre -> cs-ops-runbook.

Laura SRE: High-level RCA to be posted EOD tomorrow, full technical postmortem within 72 hours. We'll include the autoscaler diff and mitigation timeline.

Maya CS: Final confirmations before send:
- Olga: wording ok for credits + personal outreach?
- Noah: $5k cap accepted?
- Sam: Dedicated/private wording ok?
- Laura: status page link will be active once doc posted?

Olga CS-Mgr: All good. Personal outreach required for renewals/pilots.

Noah Finance: $5k cap OK. Finance will reconcile credits automatically.

Sam Product: Wording OK. Please include the pool version (v2.4) in the outbound.

Laura SRE: I'll post the status update link once we have the RCA stub; will paste link here and into the outbound before send.

Maya CS: Thanks. Send plan: automated trials outbound at 07:00 UTC tomorrow, personalized outreach to renewals/pilots and enterprise at 09:30 PT. Ravi will join outreach sync. Kofi will monitor ticket queue and flag urgent stuck jobs. Flag any blockers here. :thumbsup:
